.title-badge-icon {
    animation: glowDrift 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    transform-origin: center;
    will-change: transform, filter;
}


@keyframes glowDrift {
    0% {
        transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0px #000);
    }

    30% {
        transform: translate(20px, 15px) rotate(130deg) scale(1.05);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #000);
    }

    60% {
        transform: translate(45px, 40px) rotate(90deg) scale(0.95);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px #000);
    }

    88% {
        transform: translate(30px, 50px) rotate(90deg) scale(1.08); 
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px #444);
    }

    93% {
        transform: translate(30px, 50px) rotate(90deg) scale(0.92);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px red);
    }

    100% {
        transform: translate(30px, 50px) rotate(90deg) scale(1);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px #222);
    }
}







.title-badge-icon-right {
    animation: glowDriftOpposite 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    transform-origin: center;
    will-change: transform, filter;
}

@keyframes glowDriftOpposite {
    0% {
        transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0px #000);
    }
    30% {
        transform: translate(-20px, 15px) rotate(-120deg) scale(1.05);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px #000);
    }
    60% {
        transform: translate(-45px, 40px) rotate(-90deg) scale(0.95);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px #000);
    }
    88% {
        transform: translate(-30px, 50px) rotate(-90deg) scale(1.08);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px #444);
    }

    93% {
        transform: translate(-30px, 50px) rotate(-90deg) scale(0.92);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px red);
    }

    100% {
        transform: translate(-30px, 50px) rotate(-90deg) scale(1);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px #222);
    }
}

 <script>
    const monthlyRadio = document.getElementById('monthly');
    const yearlyRadio = document.getElementById('yearly');
    const slider = document.getElementById('slider');
    const toggleSwitch = document.getElementById('toggleSwitch');
    const monthlyPricing = document.querySelectorAll('.monthly-pricing');
    const yearlyPricing = document.querySelectorAll('.yearly-pricing');
    const monthlyLabel = document.getElementById('monthlyLabel');
    const annuallyLabel = document.getElementById('annuallyLabel');

    function updatePricingDisplay() {
      if (yearlyRadio.checked) {
        monthlyPricing.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
        yearlyPricing.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'flex');
        slider.className = 'slider yearly';
        monthlyLabel.classList.remove('active');
        annuallyLabel.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        monthlyPricing.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'flex');
        yearlyPricing.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
        slider.className = 'slider monthly';
        monthlyLabel.classList.add('active');
        annuallyLabel.classList.remove('active');
      }
    }

    toggleSwitch.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (monthlyRadio.checked) {
        yearlyRadio.checked = true;
      } else {
        monthlyRadio.checked = true;
      }
      updatePricingDisplay();
    });

    updatePricingDisplay();
  </script>
